next.reason: 1985: files in a SAME AREA clause 'that do not represent sort or merge files are to use the same memory area ... it is not valid to have more than one of these files in the open mode at the same time.' §2023:12.4.6.4.4 GR1 keeps the shared storage and 'No more than one of these files may be in the open mode at a given time'; the sort/merge exclusion (1985 §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR4) is §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR6 'shall not be specified in a file-area format SAME clause'. Both leave the one-open limit a run-time rule with no exception condition, so a conforming 1985 program means the same.
